title: SHUT UP
blurb: Not angry, exactly. Just completely, terminally finished. Exasperation in its purest distilled form, with none of the energy actual rage would require, so it works on people you love as readily as on people you do not. It is the correct response to a great many things — bad puns, unsolicited advice, anybody explaining cryptocurrency at a party where nobody asked. Play it with affection or play it with venom; the recording supports both readings and everything in between. Universal, timeless, and constantly necessary.
origin: A viral exasperated 'shut up' reaction clip.
